estimator: canonical independent ExtraTrees 64 trees leaf1 sqrt balanced; one canonical view/group
primary: old-only versus old-plus-new on fixed original 141 spectra/labels/query folds; original per-seed/fold thresholds transferred to BOTH arms
features: population-weighted physical top-two clean-subtracted spectra; training-floor signed RMS; Combined
query_guard: purge every held-out near group from training; five inherited cross-fold query groups retained explicitly; no train/test family overlap
new_outer_fold: inherit related old fold, else sha256(near_group) first8 modulo5
inner: saved old membership exactly; new unrelated groups assigned by sha256(near_group) modulo3; all validation-related groups purged
recalibration: separate arm only; common .3/.4/.5/.6, inner micro F1-.02(t-.5)^2
target1: H-only cutoff from common + [-.10,-.05,0,.05,.10], clipped[.05,.95]; inner group-weighted H F1, ties prefer unchanged; require inner all-H AUC>=.75 and >=3 positive/negative groups; cap extra CO-only false-H mass at one geometry group
target2: If inner H AUC among CO-containing cases <.80, compare training-only CO-template signed residual for H/OH; pure-CO mean template by substrate before RMS, nonnegative least-squares scalar; training features leave their entire group out of templates; original cutoff retained; unsupported template domains keep original score
residual_selection: H/OH individually activated only if grouped inner label F1 improves >=.02; H extra CO-only false-call mass <=1; no outer-score gating
templates: mean one canonical pure-CO spectrum per training group, shared relative intensity scale, no true query loading or site metadata
